fields.summary_ko.0: Samsung Electronics (206,000 KRW, +3.57%) and SK Hynix (1,277,000 KRW, +5.36%) plunged after U.S. midterm elections, yet Goldman Sachs diagnosed an oversold phase with PBR near 1.21x and 1.23x respectively, approaching historical lows.
fields.summary_ko.1: Morgan Stanley cut Samsung Electronics' price target from 381,000 KRW to 309,000 KRW (19% reduction) and SK Hynix's target from 2.6 million KRW to 1.6 million KRW (38% reduction) due to concerns over 2028 memory supply increases.
fields.summary_ko.2: Goldman Sachs expects AI infrastructure investment to grow from $1.3T in 2027 to $2T in 2028 and maintains long-term optimism, while Morgan Stanley believes sustained high profitability will be difficult from end-2027 onwards due to supply increases.
